name: agentmemory
description: AgentMemory compatibility plugin bundled with the independent Windows/Codex downstream. Technical Preview; see the repository support boundary before installing.

interface.longDescription: Recall decisions and original conversations through a local AgentMemory daemon. Includes search, exact project filters, session history, lessons, graph provenance, export and memory maintenance. Requires Node.js 24+ and the supported Windows/Codex installation. Basic keyword recall needs no model key. Local Qwen is limited to graph extraction in the managed profile. Automatic capture requires trusted, supported hooks.
